acceptanceCriteria: 部分历史重算场景必须显式输出 corrected/rebased 状态，并保留当前 absence_since 与 absence_duration。
结构化 weekly JSON 与 Markdown/HTML 的 Leader Persistence 投影必须包含该状态，且不把它写成正常 persistence 增长。
Decision、Gate、Execution、Action Matrix、Position Sizing、decision_weight 与 trade_signal 不发生变化。
通过 make fmt-check、make test、make clippy、make check-signal-context-consistency 与 make quality。
goal: 当 partial-history recomputation 改变 absence_since 或 absence_duration 基线时，报告与结构化输出必须标明 corrected/rebased，避免用户将历史回退误读为正常 persistence。
intent: 让部分历史重算导致的 Leader absence baseline 修正可追踪且显式呈现。
outOfScope: FRED observation precision；breakout presentation semantic clarity；AI Policy/Finnhub classifier；交易状态、Gate、仓位、Telegram 发送、secrets、reports/data branch 和历史 Work Item archive。

scenarioCoverage.expected: When partial history changes absence_since or absence_duration relative to the prior baseline, the model exposes an explicit corrected/rebased status while retaining current values.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add domain/read-model regression with prior baseline 2026-08-26/13 and recomputed baseline 2026-09-03/12.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Leader Persistence Markdown, HTML, and weekly JSON expose the corrected/rebased status.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: corrected/rebased status reaches all observation projections
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add report and weekly projection assertions for the corrected/rebased marker.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The change remains observation-only and does not change Decision, Gate, Execution, Action Matrix, Position Sizing, decision_weight, or trade_signal.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Reuse existing observation-only regression and assert decision fields remain unchanged.

scope: 仅修改 leader persistence 的 baseline/reconstruction provenance、TradingDaySnapshot 兼容字段、LeaderPersistenceViewModel 及 Markdown/HTML/weekly JSON 投影，并补充对应 Rust 回归测试；保持 observation-only，不改变 Decision、Gate、Execution、Action Matrix、Position Sizing。
